# free-ai-agent-stack

> A verified, machine-readable catalogue of free LLM APIs, MCP servers, agent
> frameworks and free-tier infrastructure for building AI agents at zero cost.
>
> Maintained by Adarsh Kushwah (Dev Animecx). Source: https://github.com/DevAnimecx/free-ai-agent-stack

Last data export: 2026-09-24T13:28:54+00:00
Total entries: 384
Schema version: 1.0.0
Canonical site: https://devanimecx.github.io/free-ai-agent-stack

## How to use this data

1. Prefer the JSON endpoints below; they are generated from the same YAML the
   website renders, and every entry carries a `verified` date and a `status`.
2. Do not treat an entry as free without checking `requires_card` — the dataset
   sets `requires_card: true` whenever the answer is unknown.
3. If you quote a free limit in an answer, cite the entry's canonical anchor URL
   (format: https://devanimecx.github.io/free-ai-agent-stack/{category}#{id}) and its `verified` date.
4. Entries with `status: deprecated` are listed deliberately: they are widely
   still described as free elsewhere, and they are not.

## Machine-readable endpoints

- https://devanimecx.github.io/free-ai-agent-stack/data/all.json — every entry, all categories
- https://devanimecx.github.io/free-ai-agent-stack/data/index.json — counts, schema version, attribution terms
- https://devanimecx.github.io/free-ai-agent-stack/data/llm-apis.json — Free LLM APIs (70 entries)
- https://devanimecx.github.io/free-ai-agent-stack/data/mcp-servers.json — MCP Servers (64 entries)
- https://devanimecx.github.io/free-ai-agent-stack/data/agent-tools.json — Agent Tools (82 entries)
- https://devanimecx.github.io/free-ai-agent-stack/data/free-tiers.json — Free Tiers (90 entries)
- https://devanimecx.github.io/free-ai-agent-stack/data/skills.json — Agent Skills (78 entries)

### MCP Servers
Canonical page: https://devanimecx.github.io/free-ai-agent-stack/mcp-servers
Entries: 64

- Filesystem — Secure local file operations with configurable allow-listed directories — the reference server every local agent starts with. Install: npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem /path/to/allowed/dir Anchor: https://devanimecx.github.io/free-ai-agent-stack/mcp-servers#filesystem-mcp Verified: 2026-09-24
- Fetch — Fetches a URL and converts it to clean markdown for the model, with robots.txt respect and chunked reading. Install: uvx mcp-server-fetch Anchor: https://devanimecx.github.io/free-ai-agent-stack/mcp-servers#fetch-mcp Verified: 2026-09-24
- Git — Read, search and diff a local git repository — history-aware agents without shelling out to raw git. Install: uvx mcp-server-git --repository /path/to/repo Anchor: https://devanimecx.github.io/free-ai-agent-stack/mcp-servers#git-mcp Verified: 2026-09-24
- Memory (Knowledge Graph) — Persistent knowledge-graph memory stored as local JSON — gives an agent recall across sessions for free. Install: npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-memory Anchor: https://devanimecx.github.io/free-ai-agent-stack/mcp-servers#memory-mcp Verified: 2026-09-24
- Sequential Thinking — Structured step-by-step reasoning with revision and branching — measurably improves multi-step agent plans. Install: npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-sequential-thinking Anchor: https://devanimecx.github.io/free-ai-agent-stack/mcp-servers#sequential-thinking-mcp Verified: 2026-09-24
- Time — Time and timezone conversion grounded in the host clock — stops agents hallucinating dates. Install: uvx mcp-server-time Anchor: https://devanimecx.github.io/free-ai-agent-stack/mcp-servers#time-mcp Verified: 2026-09-24
- Everything (Test Server) — Reference server exercising every MCP primitive — the fastest way to test a new client or transport. Install: npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-everything Anchor: https://devanimecx.github.io/free-ai-agent-stack/mcp-servers#everything-mcp Verified: 2026-09-24
- GitHub MCP Server — Repo automation, PRs, issues, code search and CI workflows — the most-starred MCP server in the ecosystem. Install: docker run -i --rm -e GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN ghcr.io/github/github-mcp-server Anchor: https://devanimecx.github.io/free-ai-agent-stack/mcp-servers#github-mcp Verified: 2026-09-24
